page.chem_cleanx: DPF CleanX – DPF filter cleaning fluid
chem_cleanx.seo_description: DPF CleanX cleaning fluid system for hydrodynamic DPF, FAP and GPF cleaning. FAST, EFFICIENCY and HEAVY DUTY modes. Up to 30 filters per 1L concentrate.
chem_cleanx.hero_h1: DPF CleanX – cleaning fluid system for DPF filters in hydrodynamic machines
chem_cleanx.hero_lead:
DPF CleanX is a professional cleaning fluid system for hydrodynamic cleaning of DPF, FAP and GPF filters, used in workshops and filter regeneration services.
The system is designed to operate in three modes: quick cleaning, daily operation and demanding service cases.
chem_cleanx.stat1: up to 30 DPF filters from 1L concentrate
chem_cleanx.mode_fast_desc: Ready-to-use working fluid for hydrodynamic machines—no mixing and no dosing errors.
chem_cleanx.mode_eff_desc: Professional concentrate for daily workshop use, optimised for cost per DPF filter cleaned.
chem_cleanx.mode_eff_p2: PRO 20L – high throughput / large service centres
chem_cleanx.mode_hd_desc: Advanced concentrate for tough cases—heavily clogged DPF filters with high soot and ash levels.
chem_cleanx.how_h2: How does hydrodynamic DPF cleaning work with CleanX?
chem_cleanx.how_lead:
DPF CleanX works in hydrodynamic cleaning: the chemical solution enters the cleaner’s flow path, removing soot, ash and deposits inside the DPF without damaging the filter.
The system enables repeatable, controlled filter cleaning in workshop conditions.
chem_cleanx.pick_h2: Match the operating mode to your workshop
chem_cleanx.pick_lead: DPF CleanX is not a single product—it is an operating system tailored to different service workloads.
chem_cleanx.pick_fast_line: Quick cleaning with no cleaning fluid prep
chem_cleanx.lead_h2: Not sure which DPF CleanX mode to choose?
chem_cleanx.lead_desc: We will help you select the right cleaning fluid system for your machine, workload and typical DPF cases.
chem_cleanx.lead_box: Get in touch and configure the CleanX system for your workshop
chem_cleanx.final_h2: Improve DPF cleaning results with the CleanX system
chem_cleanx.final_lead: DPF CleanX is a professional cleaning fluid system for workshops that want higher throughput and repeatable DPF regeneration.

page.privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy describes how personal data collected from you through the motsler.pl website is collected, processed, and used. This document has been prepared in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).
page.privacy_s1_court: Registry court: District Court in Rzeszów, 12th Commercial Division of the National Court Register
page.privacy_s2_a_lead: Data provided voluntarily in forms (name, e-mail, phone number, company name) is processed for the following purposes:

page.privacy_s2_a_li2: scheduling and conducting a free consultation regarding DPF machines;
page.privacy_s2_a_li3: presenting a commercial offer tailored to the client’s needs.
page.privacy_s2_a_legal: Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (necessary to take steps prior to entering into a contract) and Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interests – communication with the user).
page.privacy_s2_b_body: The website uses Google Analytics (Google Ireland Limited). This tool collects anonymous visit data (number of subpages, visit duration, device type). The data is used solely for statistical purposes and to improve the functionality of motsler.pl.
page.privacy_s2_c_body: The website uses Meta Pixel (Meta Platforms Ireland Limited). This tool enables personalised advertising to people who have visited the site and measuring the effectiveness of campaigns run on Facebook and Instagram.
page.privacy_s3_p1: The service uses cookies to tailor site content to user preferences and for analytics and marketing purposes.
page.privacy_s3_p2: Users may manage cookies (block or delete them) independently in their web browser settings.
page.privacy_s3_p3: Restricting cookies may, however, affect some features available on the site.
page.privacy_s4_lead: In connection with the processing of your data, you have the following rights:
page.privacy_s4_li1: The right of access to your data and to obtain a copy.
page.privacy_s4_li2: The right to rectification (correction) of data.
page.privacy_s4_li3: The right to erasure of data (“right to be forgotten”).
page.privacy_s4_li4: The right to object to processing (e.g. for marketing purposes).
page.privacy_s4_li5: The right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (the President of the Polish Personal Data Protection Office).

page.privacy_s5_p2: Data collected via analytics and marketing cookies is retained in accordance with the settings of those tools (typically from a few days to a few months).

offer_dpf.proc_heading: DPF filter regeneration and cleaning—step by step
offer_dpf.proc_intro_p1: Motsler machines guide you through the full DPF filter regeneration cycle in one workflow. From measurement and diagnostics through complete cleaning to the final report—without reconnecting the filter, with maximum effectiveness and safety.
offer_dpf.proc_intro_p2: Every stage is tuned for throughput, repeatable results, and time savings at your DPF cleaning point or workshop.
offer_dpf.proc_highlight_label: Why the Motsler system stands out
offer_dpf.proc_highlight: SWS—one cycle with no filter reconnects, full-depth cleaning of the filter structure, and automated process control. Your DPF regeneration machine runs faster and more repeatably at the filter cleaning station, and DPF cleaning needs less operator time.
offer_dpf.proc_step_1_text: The machine automatically measures how contaminated the filter is—the first step for a professional DPF regeneration machine in a workshop or dedicated filter cleaning point.
offer_dpf.proc_step_2_text: DPF cleaning reaches the full filter structure, removing soot and ash. The SWS system runs the entire process without reconnecting the filter between stages.
offer_dpf.proc_step_3_text: DPF, FAP, or GPF filters are dried thoroughly while keeping safety and regeneration quality—essential before the post-clean measurement.
offer_dpf.proc_step_4_text: We repeat the measurement to confirm DPF cleaning performance and maximum flow recovery.
offer_dpf.proc_step_5_text: The machine prints a professional customer report at your filter cleaning point or workshop, documenting the process and outcomes of regeneration.
offer_dpf.benefits_heading: Motsler machines—an investment that pays off
offer_dpf.benefits_intro_p1: Whether you run a filter cleaning point, manage a vehicle fleet, or operate a workshop, Motsler machines help you grow revenue, save time, and stay ahead of the competition.
offer_dpf.benefits_intro_p2: Professional DPF regeneration and cleaning in one cycle is not only margin from the service itself—it also brings customers through your door and opens space for add-on workshop work.
offer_dpf.benefits_c1_text: More filters handled per day means higher turnover. One regeneration cycle means less operator effort and happier customers.
offer_dpf.benefits_c2_text: In-house cleaning for every company vehicle cuts outsourcing costs. A fast, repeatable process keeps the fleet moving with fewer standstills.
offer_dpf.benefits_c3_text: DPF cleaning draws customers to your bay. During the same visit you can offer oil changes, brake pads, or routine inspections.

offer_dpf.s3_pfs_desc: PFS filters water in a closed loop: two reusable stainless steel pre-filters plus a main 10-micron filter with 25 m² surface area—high throughput with consistent medium cleanliness. Typical main filter replacement after 60–100 DPF filters, for predictable operating costs.

offer_dpf.s3_service: Spare parts within 48 hours and 24-hour service support.
